ranked.headline: Audits show design-model confidence, benchmarks, and screen rankings fail to certify outcomes
ranked.summary: New audits quantify when conformal guarantees, predicted confidence, and screen-derived rankings break down in CRISPR, siRNA, and protein design pipelines.

ranked.headline: Harmonized metadata and uniform reprocessing make public sequencing archives reusable
ranked.summary: New tools harmonize SRA, BioProject and GEO metadata as NCBI, CNCB-NGDC and PANTHER release 2027 updates to core archives and annotation resources.

ranked.headline: Atlases, spatial repositories and multimodal tools turn cell-level data into disease context
ranked.summary: New atlases, spatial repositories and perturbation benchmarks are being paired with neighborhood-aware tools for tumor annotation and clinical prediction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks probe where AI structure models fall short on poses, disorder and dynamics
ranked.summary: New benchmarks test structure predictors against glycan poses, NMR chemical shifts and disordered-protein ensembles, locating where static models fall short.

ranked.headline: Joint signature inference and DNA language models refine somatic mutation modeling
ranked.summary: MOTET and EAGLE-MUT extend somatic mutation modeling beyond single-class signatures; parallel TF work tests motif discovery and cooperativity.

ranked.headline: Structure-linked databases add AlphaFold and predicted-model content and machine-actionable API access
ranked.summary: Six database updates pair expanded structure, ligand and disorder annotation with versioned APIs, MCP servers and workflows for programmatic and agentic access.

ranked.headline: Evaluation design, not model novelty, increasingly determines credibility of omics-based clinical prediction
ranked.summary: New studies show metric choice and same-modality validation can inflate performance, while cross-platform and cross-cohort tests expose how fragile it is.

ranked.headline: Protein language models are probed for invariance failures while biophysical priors are added
ranked.summary: New preprints expose protein language model failures under relabeling and layer probing while adding dynamics, electrostatics and energy-based signals to variant and binding tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and graph models test prediction of enzyme function and metabolic network behavior
ranked.summary: New benchmarks expose how well methods predict EC numbers, enzyme catalysis, gene essentiality and causal structure in kinetic networks, including with latent variables.

ranked.headline: Full-length and depth-aware isoform profiling expands heart and aging transcriptomes, paired with portals
ranked.summary: Long-read heart isoform atlas, mouse aging isoform switching and splicing depth guidelines show isoform-level analysis needs matched sequencing and accessible tools.

ranked.headline: Statistical frameworks target dependence structure in association, mediation and co-expression analyses
ranked.summary: New mediation, family-based trait-disease testing, and precision matrix benchmarking address inference under high dimensionality and correlated data.

ranked.headline: Binder design moves toward multi-variant, all-atom, and latent-space affinity-guided generation
ranked.summary: Five new reports span all-atom de novo design, multi-variant antibody optimization, and peptide binder generation, with training-data simulation for peptide binding.

ranked.headline: Multimodal single-cell atlases link chromatin state, expression and genetic variation across human and mouse brain
ranked.summary: Four Cell papers on 12 Nov 2026 report multimodal and population-scale brain atlases, with human basal ganglia and striatum central.

ranked.headline: Analysis pipeline choices flip or create reported effects in brain-model and network comparisons
ranked.summary: Three preprints show analysis choices alter conclusions in model-brain RSA and EEG rich-club work, and one audits a brain-response model against sensory maps.

ranked.headline: Modular, reusable representations of phage, mobile element and accessory gene content in microbial genomes
ranked.summary: New phage fragment annotations, a 16.4M-element MGE database, a prophage workflow and S. aureus NMF modules expand structured views of microbial genome content.

ranked.headline: Transformers and ensembles infer cell states across histology, spatial, RNA and chromatin data
ranked.summary: Eight November 2026 reports use transformers, flow matching and ensembles to infer cellular profiles and labels across modalities and resolutions.

ranked.headline: Explicit force models link filament and cell mechanics to emergent stress patterns across scales
ranked.summary: Five preprints in one week model how mechanical feedback and force transmission organize structure from the actomyosin cortex to whole tissues.

ranked.headline: Generative and structured latent models infer, impute and simulate expression across space, age and kinetics
ranked.summary: Preprints and papers pair generative simulators with spatial and kinetic structure to reconstruct, benchmark and interpret transcriptomic variation.

ranked.headline: Enhanced sampling and learned models resolve multimodal conformational ensembles of proteins and RNA
ranked.summary: Four preprints pair physics-based sampling with learned latent spaces or generative models to map multiple binding modes and conformational states.

ranked.headline: Prior knowledge and learned representations drive prediction of responses to unseen perturbations
ranked.summary: Three preprints add structured priors and denoised representations for unseen-perturbation response prediction, while two published papers extend knowledge-guided property prediction.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic models separate technical noise from genetic effects in single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell studies increasingly pair perturbation readouts with explicit noise, batch, and genotype models, making statistical assumptions central to state inference.

ranked.headline: Pathway and spatial methods map condition-dependent shifts in regulatory organization
ranked.summary: Spatial causal and correlation-function methods now enable condition-contrastive regulatory analysis in human liver tissue.

ranked.headline: Long-read assemblies resolve centromere, telomere and structural variation
ranked.summary: Near-complete assemblies from long reads now expose centromere, telomere and immune-region variation in oyster, pig and malaria parasite genomes.

ranked.headline: Re-engineered pipelines speed up sequencing, CRISPR screen, and CLIP data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent releases package established genomic, CRISPR screen, and CLIP analysis steps into faster, more automated, locally runnable tools.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes enable exact-match search across terabase genome assemblies
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply compressed-space indexes to terabase assemblies, long reads, and haplotype selection, with several reporting speedups over existing tools.

ranked.headline: Structure confidence and conformal calibration probe reliability of biomolecular ML
ranked.summary: Structural confidence and sequence-based scores are being tested as selection filters, exposing failure modes outside training distributions.

ranked.headline: Models resolve noncoding variant effects on regulation across cell types and lineages
ranked.summary: Recent models score regulatory variants at genome scale, from 6.48M precomputed gnomAD effects to 302,830 lineage-resolved noncoding variants.

ranked.headline: Cross-species spatial and single-cell atlases map primate basal ganglia cell types
ranked.summary: Harmonized multimodal atlases now align human, macaque, marmoset, and mouse basal ganglia cell taxonomies across spatial and single-cell modalities.

ranked.headline: Curated cross-species databases expand annotation of miRNAs, snoRNAs, and RBP target sites
ranked.summary: Four 2026 database releases broaden cross-species coverage of miRNA, snoRNA, and RBP target annotation in model organisms.

ranked.headline: Spatial transcriptomics methods infer cell-state dynamics from velocity fields
ranked.summary: Time-resolved and spatial transcriptomics now supply the data to infer cell-state transitions and their drivers directly from expression.

ranked.headline: Polymer models probe cohesin extrusion, looping inference and chromatin structure
ranked.summary: Polymer and coarse-grained simulations now test how well microscopy and single-molecule measurements constrain chromatin looping and loop extrusion.

ranked.headline: LLM agents gate omics analysis on assumption and calibration checks before execution
ranked.summary: LLM-driven biomedical workflows are now evaluated on whether their outputs satisfy validity conditions, not only on task accuracy.

ranked.headline: Pretrained genomic and mRNA models adapted for regulatory and modification prediction
ranked.summary: Sequence foundation models are now specialized for modifications, regulatory marks, and mRNA regions, making evaluation design decisive.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale models link microbial stoichiometry, translation, and curated metabolism
ranked.summary: Expanded ME-model and curated genome-scale frameworks now test stoichiometric and proteome-level constraints across bacteria and fungi.

ranked.headline: Learned models recover structure from noisy cryo-EM/ET and fluorescence microscopy data
ranked.summary: Learned models now recover structural information from noisy, heterogeneous microscopy data using same-sample noise statistics and fidelity constraints.

ranked.headline: Time-explicit models relate developmental pace, protein epistasis and B cell lineages
ranked.summary: Three new studies apply explicit time-resolved models to developmental aging, protein evolution and B cell lineage tracing.

ranked.headline: Local differential privacy applied to genomic data sharing and population stratification
ranked.summary: Genomic data sharing and synthetic expression data generation are being benchmarked and audited for privacy leakage before release.

ranked.headline: Indexed genome graphs and RNA structure editors advance interactive visualization
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication add fast GFA indexing, editable RNA structure figures, and batch motif visualization in PyMOL.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models extend protein binding-site prediction beyond sequence alone
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published study add three-dimensional binding context to sequence and ligand models for interfaces, ternary complexes and pockets.

ranked.headline: Integrative resources connect molecular influences to drug response and resistance
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a database release integrate natural-product, infectious-disease, and kinase mutation data into queryable resources for drug discovery.
